players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (ankle) as of 1:39 PM PT Oct 24. Earlier: Jackson (high-ankle sprain) was limited all week and is officially questionable for Sunday vs. Cincinnati after missing the last two games; the Ravens call him a game-time decision, with Tyler Huntley starting if he can't go.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: Mayfield (right thumb) practiced all week and is officially questionable on the Oct. 23 final report, but Todd Bowles said he will most likely start Sunday at Carolina in his first game since Sept. 27.

players.name: Jalon Daniels
players.note: With Baker Mayfield expected to return from his thumb injury Sunday at Carolina (per Bowles on Oct. 23), Daniels heads back to the bench.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Beck (back spasms) did not practice Thursday or Friday and is questionable for Sunday vs. Denver, but he is expected to be inactive. Jacoby Brissett starts.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: The Giants named McCarthy their Week 7 starter at Houston over Jameis Winston, and with Jaxson Dart out for the season the job is his.

players.name: Jameis Winston
players.note: Winston was benched for J.J. McCarthy during the Week 6 loss to New Orleans and goes back to the Giants' backup role for Week 7 at Houston.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: Dart remains on IR and is out for the season. J.J. McCarthy is now the Giants' starter.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: Hurts (blood clots in lungs) remains on IR and is out for the 2026 season. Tanner McKee is Philadelphia's starter for the foreseeable future.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.note: Hall (quad) was limited again Friday (Oct 23) and is officially questionable for Sunday vs. Miami; Aaron Glenn says the call will come down to how he feels Saturday and could go up to game day.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: Breece Hall (quad) is questionable for Week 7 vs. Miami after two limited practices (Oct 22-23); Allen starts again if Hall sits, but faces a split if Hall plays.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Barkley (hamstring) was limited again Friday (Oct 23) ahead of Monday night vs. Dallas; the Eagles may rule on him after Saturday's practice, and he could be a game-time decision if he doesn't get to a full practice.

players.name: Dameon Pierce
players.note: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) was limited Thursday and Friday (Oct 22-23) and is still in line to play Monday vs. Dallas, which would end Pierce's run as the lead back.

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was on injured reserve) as of 2:41 PM PT Oct 24. Earlier: Mason (thumb) practiced fully all week and is questionable on the Friday (Oct 23) report only because he is still on IR; Kevin O'Connell expects him to be activated and play Sunday vs. Indianapolis.

players.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
players.note: Jordan Mason (thumb) is expected to be activated from IR for Sunday vs. the Colts after full practices all week (Oct 23 report), so Jones should go from his career-high 28-touch workload back to a shared backfield.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was on injured reserve) as of 9:43 AM PT Oct 24. Earlier: Sampson (knee) is questionable for Sunday at Tennessee on the Oct 23 report and must be activated from IR by Saturday evening; with Judkins back, he would likely fill a passing-down role.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: Judkins (ankle) is not on Cleveland's final Week 7 injury report (Oct 23) and should resume his usual lead workload Sunday at Tennessee after a one-game absence.

players.name: Jaleel McLaughlin
players.note: Quinshon Judkins is off the final injury report and Dylan Sampson is questionable to come off IR for Sunday at Tennessee (Oct 23), which pushes McLaughlin back to a depth role.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (ankle) as of 2:41 PM PT Oct 24. Earlier: Coleman (ankle) logged a third straight full practice and is questionable for Sunday at Arizona (Oct 23 report); he is expected to be activated from IR Saturday, but Sean Payton said he'll be 'mindful' of his snaps.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.note: Seattle ruled Charbonnet (ACL) out for Sunday vs. Kansas City on Friday (Oct 23) but plans to activate him off injured reserve Saturday, which points to a debut after Week 7.

players.name: Emanuel Wilson
players.note: Zach Charbonnet was ruled out Friday (Oct 23) for Sunday vs. Kansas City, so Wilson keeps his backfield share for Week 7 before Charbonnet likely cuts into it afterward.

players.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
players.note: Robinson (hamstring) did not practice Friday (Oct 23) and was ruled out for Sunday vs. San Francisco.

players.name: Bijan Robinson
players.note: With Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) ruled out Friday (Oct 23), Bijan should handle the bulk of Atlanta's carries Sunday vs. San Francisco, with Khalil Herbert expected to be elevated from the practice squad as the backup.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Mike LaFleur ruled Love (ankle) out for Sunday vs. Denver at his Friday press conference (Oct 23), his second straight missed game.

players.name: Tyler Allgeier
players.note: With Jeremiyah Love (ankle) officially ruled out Friday (Oct 23), Allgeier is expected to start again Sunday vs. Denver, with Bam Knight mixing in.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Sleeper lists Montgomery (groin) out for Week 7 vs. the Giants after he missed practice all week; with Houston's Week 8 bye, Week 9 is his likely return.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: With David Montgomery (groin) out for Sunday vs. the Giants, Marks is set to lead Houston's backfield again in Week 7.

players.name: Mike Washington Jr.
players.note: Washington (foot/back) did not practice Thursday or Friday (Oct 22-23) and is questionable vs. the Rams; Klint Kubiak said Friday he expects him to play, but the missed practices make him risky.

players.name: Rico Dowdle
players.note: Dowdle (knee) was limited Friday (Oct 23) and is questionable for Sunday vs. New Orleans, though reports don't view him as at serious risk of missing the game.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Spears (knee) is officially questionable for Sunday vs. Cleveland on the Titans' Friday (Oct 23) report.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.note: The final Week 7 injury report (Oct 23) rules him out at Carolina with concussion and foot injuries. He remains in the concussion protocol, so his Week 8 status is still uncertain.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: He is officially out for Week 7 at Atlanta (hamstring) on the final injury report, along with Mike Evans. He is aiming to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (hamstring) as of 1:39 PM PT Oct 24. Earlier: He is listed questionable (hamstring) on the final Week 7 injury report heading into Sunday's game against Dallas. Check inactives before lineups lock.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: He is on IR with a ruptured hamstring that needs surgery and is out again in Week 7. Sean McVay said Oct 19-20 that he will miss 6-10 weeks.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: He was ruled out Oct 18 with an AC joint shoulder injury. Buffalo is on bye in Week 7, which gives him more time to heal.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: He stays on IR (heel). Shane Steichen said Oct 19 that Pierce's practice window will not open in Week 7, so his return is pushed back further.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Sleeper lists him questionable (quadriceps) for Week 7. He has not played since Week 2, and no Friday update was found confirming that he will play.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.note: Terry McLaurin is out for the season with a torn patellar tendon (confirmed Oct 20). Williams is expected to take on a bigger role next to Stefon Diggs starting in Week 7.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: He had 12 targets on Oct 18 and is Pittsburgh's WR2, with Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson (IR) out. Ben Skowronek was also ruled out for Week 7 against New Orleans.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: With Romeo Doubs on IR since Oct 19, Douglas is a top target alongside A.J. Brown. New England already played Week 7, a 30-24 loss at Chicago on Oct 22.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: He practiced fully on Oct 21 (hamstring) after missing Week 5 and Minnesota's bye. He is set to return as a starter in Week 7 against the Colts.

players.name: Jaylin Noel
players.note: Tank Dell (knee) is expected to make his 2026 debut in Week 7 against the Giants (reported Oct 20). Houston also added Marvin Harrison Jr. by trade on Oct 12, which crowds Noel's path to targets.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: He saw five targets in his Oct 18 return from IR and is pushing for the WR2 role in Baltimore. Rashod Bateman (shoulder) is expected to be OK for Week 7 against Cincinnati, which limits Lane's upside.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Nacua (calf) sat out Friday's practice (Oct 23) and is officially questionable for Sunday at Las Vegas, a game-time decision. Sean McVay called the injury minor, and testing reportedly showed it was less serious than first feared.

players.name: Konata Mumpfield
players.note: With Davante Adams out with a ruptured hamstring and Puka Nacua questionable after missing Friday's practice (Oct 23), Mumpfield is in line for an expanded Week 7 role at Las Vegas.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: The Chiefs ruled Rice (hamstring) out Friday, Oct 23, for Sunday night's game at Seattle after he missed practice all week. That makes two straight missed games.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: The 49ers officially ruled Evans (ribs/Achilles) out on Friday, Oct 23, for Sunday at Atlanta, along with Deebo Samuel. With San Francisco on a Week 8 bye, Week 9 is the earliest he can return, and that is uncertain.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:41 PM PT Oct 24.

players.name: Ted Hurst III
players.note: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) was ruled out Friday, Oct 23, for Sunday vs. Carolina, and Hurst is projected for about 80% of snaps and a larger target share. He has 11 catches for 168 yards and a TD on 22 targets this season.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon in the Oct 19 MNF game and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.note: McLaurin's season-ending patellar tendon tear (Oct 19) makes Diggs Washington's clear top WR for the rest of 2026.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey is still in the concussion protocol after the Oct 18 game. The Chargers' Week 7 bye gives him time to clear it before Week 8.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: Harris (hamstring) missed the Oct 18 game, and the Chargers are on bye in Week 7. Week 8 is the earliest he can return.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) has been on IR since Oct 19 and is out at least through Week 10.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Burden led Chicago with 4 catches for 130 yards and a TD in the 30-24 TNF win over New England on Oct 22. It was his second straight game outproducing Rome Odunze.

players.name: Rome Odunze
players.note: Odunze caught 4 of 5 targets for 69 yards in the Oct 22 TNF win, and Luther Burden outproduced him for the second straight week. His target share is a growing concern.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson (hamstring) remains on IR without an opened practice window. Reports point to a Week 9 return after the Saints' Week 8 bye.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Lamar Jackson (ankle) is officially questionable for Sunday vs. Cincinnati, and Tyler Huntley would start if he can't go. Flowers himself carries no injury designation.

players.name: Colston Loveland
players.note: Ben Johnson confirmed Friday, Oct 23 that Cole Kmet's knee injury is season-ending, and Kmet is going on IR. That leaves Loveland as Chicago's clear TE1, with Sam Roush moving up to TE2.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:39 PM PT Oct 24. Earlier: Goedert (knee) missed practice again Friday, Oct 23, so he has not practiced at all ahead of Monday night's game vs. Dallas. The Eagles' final report comes Saturday, and he is on the wrong side of questionable.

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.note: Shane Steichen ruled Warren (groin) out Friday, Oct 23 for Sunday's game at Minnesota. It will be his second straight missed game, and Mo Alie-Cox and Will Mallory will handle the tight end snaps.

players.name: George Kittle
players.note: Mike Evans was officially ruled out on San Francisco's final Week 7 injury report (Oct 23), and Ricky Pearsall is already on IR. That concentrates targets on Kittle for Sunday at Atlanta, and he has no injury designation.

players.name: Bucky Irving
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 10:42 AM PT Oct 23. Earlier: Irving (illness) returned to practice as a limited participant Thursday (Oct 22) after sitting Wednesday, and his availability for Week 7 at Carolina does not appear to be in danger.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 4:41 PM PT Oct 22. Earlier: Bowers was limited in practice Wednesday, Oct 21 with a new hamstring/calf designation. It is unclear whether he got hurt in Week 6 or at practice, but reports still give him a good chance to play vs. the Rams.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:46 PM PT Oct 23. Earlier: He was limited at practice Wednesday, Oct 21 (finger) after a minor procedure in mid-October. He is questionable for Week 7 against Miami and has missed four straight games.

players.name: Jaylen Wright
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:46 PM PT Oct 23.

players.name: Matthew Golden
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:46 PM PT Oct 23. Earlier: Golden (shoulder) was limited Wednesday and Thursday (Oct 21-22). Matt LaFleur said he has no concern about his availability for Sunday at Detroit.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (toe) as of 12:44 PM PT Oct 21. Earlier: Monangai (turf toe) has missed Weeks 5 and 6, was last reported in a boot and week-to-week, and is listed questionable as of Oct 21. The short week to Thursday's game vs. New England (Oct 22) makes a return unlikely.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:46 PM PT Oct 23. Earlier: He was limited at practice Wednesday, Oct 21 (ankle) and has not played since Week 2. He is working toward a return in Week 7 against the Jets on Oct 25.

players.name: KC Concepcion Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 11:52 AM PT Oct 23. Earlier: Concepcion (calf/quadriceps) was limited in practice again on Thursday, Oct 22, his second straight limited session. His status for Sunday against Tennessee depends on Friday's report.

players.name: Matt Hibner
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:43 PM PT Oct 22. Earlier: Hibner (hand) was upgraded to limited practice on Wednesday, Oct 21 after missing Week 6, and could return Sunday vs. Cincinnati. Mark Andrews remains Baltimore's lead tight end.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 11:52 AM PT Oct 23. Earlier: Sleeper listed him questionable (foot) as of Oct 21 heading into Week 7. The same foot issue limited him before Week 6, but he played that week.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:43 PM PT Oct 23. Earlier: Kelce (ankle) was limited again Thursday, Oct 22, and is still expected to play Sunday night at Seattle unless something changes at Friday's practice.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 7:44 PM PT Oct 21.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:51 AM PT Oct 23.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:46 PM PT Oct 23. Earlier: Hockenson (concussion) practiced in full on Wednesday, Oct 21, and needs clearance from an independent neurologist to play Oct 25 vs. Indianapolis. He is trending toward playing.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:44 PM PT Oct 21. Earlier: He was limited (ankle) on the Patriots' Oct 20 practice report before Thursday's game at Chicago. With Romeo Doubs (shoulder) on IR, he should see more targets if he plays.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 3:42 PM PT Oct 22. Earlier: Jefferson (ankle) was limited in practice on Wed Oct 21 before Sunday's game against the Colts, which reports described as a maintenance day. He said afterward that the ankle feels good.

players.name: Jordan Love
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:44 PM PT Oct 22. Earlier: Love (back) was limited on the Packers' estimated Wednesday report on Oct 21 and got no game designation. He said there is 'no chance' he misses Sunday at Detroit.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:43 PM PT Oct 23. Earlier: Sleeper listed him questionable (chest) as of Oct 21 heading into Week 7.

players.name: Rashod Bateman
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:43 PM PT Oct 22.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:46 PM PT Oct 23. Earlier: Sleeper listed him questionable (shoulder) as of Oct 22 heading into Week 7.

players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:46 PM PT Oct 23. Earlier: Sleeper listed him questionable (ankle) as of Oct 21 heading into Week 7.

players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 4:41 PM PT Oct 22.
